newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American in $1.2 bln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American in $1.2 bln credit pact.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said Thursday it has signed a commitment for up to $1.2 billion in an unsecured revolving credit facility and a secured term loan facility with PaineWebber Real Estate Securities Inc and Chase Manhattan Bank, respectively.
PaineWebber Real Estate is a unit of PaineWebber Group Inc, and Chase Manhattan of Chase Manhattan Corp.
The hotel real estate investment trust also said it had terminated an agreement with an unspecified lender for up to $1.4 billion in secured credit facilities.
Paul Nussbaum, Patriot's chairman and chief operating officer, said the company negotiated with PaineWebber and Chase Manhattan to achieve more favorable pricing and status as an unsecured borrower.

The new credit facilities are structured as a three-year $700 million unsecured revolving credit facility and a $500 million non-recourse five-year term loan secured by a to-be-agreed-upon pool of hotel assets, he said.

Patriot will use the revolving credit facility to repay debt, acquire additional properties, businesses and other assets, and for capital expenditures and for general working capital purposes, he said.

The proceeds of the term loans will be applied mainly to finance cash payments made in connection with Patriot's acquisition of Wyndham Hotel Corp and the related acquisition of 11 hotels from partnerships affiliated with members of the Trammell Crow family, he said.
